decision.label: ANSWER
decision.response: Your adviser's plan matches the S5 four-part regimen for garlic on Vertisols (Diriba et al., 2015): 92 kg N + 40 kg P + 30 kg S per hectare combined with 140 kg KCl product per hectare. The first three amounts (92 kg N, 40 kg P, 30 kg S) are expressed as NUTRIENTS per hectare, not bags of fertilizer; the 140 kg is a KCl PRODUCT rate per hectare. For your 0.22 ha field, multiplying each per-hectare rate by 0.22 gives: nitrogen 92 × 0.22 = 20.24 kg N; phosphorus 40 × 0.22 = 8.8 kg P; sulfur 30 × 0.22 = 6.6 kg S; KCl 140 × 0.22 = 30.8 kg KCl product. Note that S5 does not specify which fertilizer products supply the N, P, or S, nor application timing for this four-part regimen, so these are nutrient amounts to be supplied, not bag counts.
decision.justification: The adviser's figures exactly match the S5 combined regimen r_c12_n/r_c12_p/r_c12_s/r_c12_kcl, whose condition (soil_type IN [Andosols, Vertisols]) is satisfied by the explicit Vertisol fact and whose crop is garlic. These rules state the N, P, and S amounts on a nutrient basis (kg N/ha, kg P/ha, kg S/ha) and the KCl amount on a product basis (kg KCl/ha), which directly answers whether the first three are nutrients rather than bags. The per-field totals are simple proportional scaling by the explicit area 0.22 ha. S5 provides no product-source or timing data for the N/P/S components, so no bag conversion is offered.
